patthana15.4:1.1: hetuṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.4:2.1: na hetuṃ anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana15.4:3.1: hetuṃ anupādinna anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
